meta.parties: Babee Et Al v. Naida Et Al

rules.statement: A deed of gift containing a condition that the property shall be held and possessed by certain individuals or their descendants, followed by a qualification regarding alienation, can create an express fideicommissum if the first part is sufficient to create such a trust.
rules.supporting_quote: "Where there is an express fideicommissum,, the apparent nudity of the express prohibition imposed on the fiduciaries is immaterial to the existence of the fideicommissum."
